data.name: Hasnaina
data.gender_notes: Hasnaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A praiseworthy and commendable name that reflects the qualities of a virtuous person. The name Hasnaina carries the meaning “Praiseworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasnaina usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: According to Quranic hadith, a name that signifies a person who is praised for their good deeds.
data.etymology: Hasnaina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiseworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasnaina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: حسنائنا
in_arabic.meaning: حسنائنا تعني الجميلة والمشرقة والمتألقة بالخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسنائنا هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل حسن، ويعني الجميلة والمشرقة والمتألقة بالخير. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الفعل في القرآن الكريم، مثل قوله تعالى: {وإذا رأيت الذين كفروا فإنهم يضاحكون} {حسناً} أي جميلاً. واسم حسنائنا يوحي بالجمال والكمال الروحي والخلقي.

in_urdu.name: حسنائنا
in_urdu.meaning: حسنائنا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، نیک، اور اچھی
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسنائنا ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت، نیک، اور اچھی۔ یہ نام حسن کے فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ اچھائی اور خوبی کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، حسنائنا جیسے ناموں کو اچھے اخلاق اور نیک خصائل کی ترغیب کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसनाइना
in_hindi.meaning: हसनाइना का अर्थ है सुंदर, अच्छी और नेक
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसनाइना एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर, अच्छी और नेक। यह नाम 'हसन' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जो अच्छाई और सुंदरता की ओर इशारा करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, हसनाइना जैसे नामों को अच्छे चरित्र और नैतिकता को बढ़ावा देने के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: حسناینا
in_pashto.meaning: حسناینا د ښې او نيکۍ معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسناینا د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د ښې، نيکۍ، او خوبۍ معنا لري. دا نوم د 'حسن' کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د ښېګړې او نيکۍ ښودنه کوي. د افغانستان او پښتنو په دوديزو کې، داسې نومونه د ښې سلوکې او اخلاقو د هڅونې په توګه ليدل کيږي.

in_english.name: Hasnaina
in_english.meaning: Beautiful, good, and radiant with virtue
in_english.long_meaning: Hasnaina is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'hasan,' meaning to be good or beautiful. The name signifies beauty, goodness, and virtue. In Islamic tradition, names like Hasnaina are chosen to inspire good character and moral excellence. The root 'hasan' appears in the Quran, emphasizing the value of beauty and goodness.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: حسناینا

In the broader cultural context, it signifies the importance of physical and moral beauty, and being proud of one's appearance and character. In many Muslim communities, the naming of children is a significant event, and the choice of a name is given much thought and consideration to ensure it embodies positive traits and reflects the values of the family and society.

In Islamic teachings, it is emphasized that true beauty is not just about physical appearance but also about inner qualities such as kindness, generosity, and humility. The name serves as a constant reminder to strive for personal growth and to cultivate good habits, as this is what truly makes a person beautiful in the eyes of God. Ultimately, the name "Hasnaina" is a reminder to be proud of both our outer and inner selves, and to aspire to be a virtuous and commendable individual in all aspects of our lives.
